message:
Ever found yourself rummaging through drawers for candles during a blackout, only to realize you’re out of matches? 😂 I’ve been there! It’s a bit of a comedy, really, when we forget to prep for those unexpected moments. I came across a great resource that offers some handy tips on how to stay comfortable and safe during power outages. 

It’s a gentle reminder that a little bit of planning can save us from those "uh-oh" moments. What’s your favorite tip or trick for staying cozy when the lights go out?
